stories.title: Cleanup underway in Central California after storm brings strong winds topple trees, cause outages
stories.summary: City crews spent Thursday clearing debris and responding to storm-related incidents across Fresno after a weather system brought heavy rain, hail and strong winds to the region.

stories.title: Rain holds off as One Enchanted Evening kicks off holiday season in Old Town Clovis
stories.summary: Wet roads and scattered showers did little to dampen the holiday spirit Thursday evening as shoppers gathered in Old Town Clovis for One Enchanted Evening, the community's annual holiday kickoff event.

stories.title: Children First: Decoding Our Digital World
stories.summary: For today's children, technology is part of everyday life, but the digital world also comes with growing risks and new challenges for families.

stories.title: Fresno nonprofits partner to transform bedrooms for local children
stories.summary: Local nonprofits, volunteers and members of the Fresno Police Department partnered to create new bedroom spaces for five Fresno children, including two young brothers from Kirk Elementary.

stories.title: Dine and Dish: Santa Fe Basque
stories.summary: A longtime Fresno restaurant is continuing the traditions of Basque boarding houses through large family-style meals, homemade dishes and a focus on bringing people together around the table.

stories.title: Jury finds Fresno man guilty of first-degree murder
stories.summary: After less than a day of deliberations, a jury has found Stewart Coleman guilty of first-degree murder. Coleman was accused of murdering 70-year-old Carl Johnson in Northwest Fresno back in August 2025.

stories.title: AccuWeather Forecast
stories.summary: Watch the latest AccuWeather forecast on ABC30 Action News.

stories.title: The herd heads into the Lost World in new 'Ice Age: Boiling Point' trailer
stories.summary: The herd is back in action as the new "Ice Age: Boiling Point" trailer teases a dinosaur-filled trip into the Lost World. See who is joining the voice cast before the film arrives in theaters Feb. 5, 2027.

stories.title: Fresno responds to storm impacts as thunderstorms bring rain, wind and hail to the area
stories.summary: The latest winter storms moved across the Valley on Thursday, bringing thunderstorm activity to Fresno County, including brief heavy downpours, strong wind gusts and hail.

stories.title: Fresno County leaders eye new transportation tax proposal for 2028 election
stories.summary: Members of the "No on Measure S" coalition gathered Thursday to celebrate the apparent outcome and outline their vision for a future transportation funding measure.

stories.title: Nearly 10,000 pounds of lead azide to be detonated at Iowa Army plant, causing lead dust plume into Illinois
stories.summary: Two rapid controlled detonations scheduled to take place at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown on Friday have been postponed by three days.

stories.title: Study finds 1 in 6 U.S. teens report moderate to severe anxiety symptoms
stories.summary: A recent study found that one in six U.S. teenagers reports moderate to severe anxiety symptoms, and many are not getting help.
